hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f || exit 0; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$f" in */node_modules/*|*/.nuxt/*|*/.output/*) exit 0 ;; esac; npx --no-install prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f"; case "$f" in *.vue|*.ts|*.js|*.mjs|*.cjs) npx --no-install eslint --fix --no-warn-ignored "$f" ;; esac; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
